map.自动判断可逆性，不可逆时给出提示: Automatically judges invertibility and prompts if not invertible

map.若提示不可逆，先检查行列式是否为 0（可用行列式工具验证）: If it reports non-invertible, first check whether the determinant is 0 (verify with the determinant tool)
map.用原矩阵乘逆矩阵应得单位矩阵，可用矩阵乘法工具复核: Multiplying the original matrix by its inverse should give the identity matrix; cross-check with the matrix multiplication tool
map.此时应检查数据是否存在高度相关的列，或改用伪逆、正则化等更稳健的方法: Then check whether highly correlated columns exist in the data, or switch to more robust methods such as the pseudoinverse or regularization
map.不可逆矩阵能求伪逆吗？: Can a non-invertible matrix have a pseudoinverse?
map.可用 Moore-Penrose 伪逆作为近似解。: The Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse can serve as an approximate solution.
map.为什么结果里出现极大或极小的数？: Why do very large or very small numbers appear in the result?
map.说明矩阵接近奇异（病态）——行列式接近 0，微小输入误差会被放大成巨大输出偏差。: It means the matrix is nearly singular (ill-conditioned) - the determinant is near zero, so small input errors get amplified into large output deviations. Numerical work measures this with the condition number: the larger it is, the less reliable. Then check whether highly correlated columns exist in the data, or switch to more robust methods such as the pseudoinverse or regularization.
